mapper.select: SELECT id, project_id, title, description, status, priority, assignee, due_date, created_at, updated_at FROM tasks WHERE 1 = 1 AND project_id = #{projectId} AND status = #{status} AND (title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR description LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%')) ORDER BY FIELD(status, 'TODO', 'IN_PROGRESS', 'REVIEW', 'PAUSED', 'DONE'), id
